story.definition: Search both voices for globally optimal phase pairs within a mismatch budget.
story.design_decl: op infer_phase(observed: Cycle, a: Cycle, b: Cycle, budget: Int) -> List<Pair<Int,Int,Int,Int>> = sorted(all (errors, ?offbeat{mixed}, p, q) with mixed=@weave[identity,identity](left(a,p),left(b,q)), errors=phase_score(observed,mixed,0).errors <= budget and errors globally minimal); length(a),length(b) <= 32; lcm <= 512; empty if none   L12
